GET /v1/credential-schemas.description: List credential schemas for your tenant. Each schema defines a VCT (Verifiable Credential Type), credential format, attributes, revocability, status, and version lineage. Use this before you create templates or issue credentials.

200.description: Array of credential schemas. Each array element contains these fields.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the credential schema. You use it to fetch the schema or create templates.

vct.description: VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) value embedded in credentials issued from this schema.

format.description: Credential format. The captured value is `sd_jwt_vc`, the SD-JWT VC (Selective-Disclosure JWT Verifiable Credential) format.

attributes.description: Claim attributes that make up the credential.

name.description: Claim name as it appears in the credential.

sd.description: Whether the claim supports selective disclosure.

branding.description: Wallet branding object returned with the schema. The captured examples are empty objects.

revocable.description: Whether issued credentials from this schema can be revoked.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this schema version.

supersedes.description: Schema UUID that this version supersedes. Null means this is the first version.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the schema was created.

name.description: Claim name as it appears in the credential.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this schema version.

supersedes.description: Schema UUID that this version supersedes. Null means this is the first version.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the schema was created.

POST /v1/credential-schemas/{uuid}/revok.description: Bulk revoke live credentials issued under one schema version. Use this carefully because it is destructive for affected credentials. The response tells you how many credentials were revoked.

params.name: uuid
params.description: UUID of the credential schema version whose credentials you want to revoke.

200.description: The credentials issued under this schema version were revoked.

revoked.description: Number of credentials revoked by the bulk operation.

schema_id.description: UUID of the schema version used for the bulk revoke.

version.description: Version string of the schema version used for the bulk revoke.

GET /v1/credential-templates.description: List credential templates for your tenant. A template binds a schema to an issuance profile. Use a template UUID when you issue a credential.

200.description: Array of credential templates. Each array element contains these fields.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the credential template.

schema.description: UUID of the schema bound to this template.

validity_seconds.description: Credential validity duration, in seconds, applied during issuance.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the template was created.

POST /v1/credential-templates.description: Create an issuance template for a credential schema. You provide the schema UUID, template name, and validity duration. Use the returned template UUID when you issue credentials.

schema.description: UUID of the schema to bind to this template.

validity_seconds.description: Credential validity duration, in seconds, applied during issuance.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the credential template.

schema.description: UUID of the schema bound to this template.

validity_seconds.description: Credential validity duration, in seconds, applied during issuance.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the template was created.

POST /v1/credentials/issue.description: Issue an SD-JWT VC (Selective-Disclosure JWT Verifiable Credential) to a holder. You provide a template UUID, the holder public JWK (JSON Web Key), and claim values. The API returns the issued credential identifier and serialized credential.

template_id.description: UUID of the credential template to issue from.

holder_jwk.description: Holder public key as a JWK (JSON Web Key). The credential is bound to this key.

crv.description: Elliptic curve name in the JWK (JSON Web Key).

x.description: X coordinate of the public key.

y.description: Y coordinate of the public key.

claims.description: Credential claim values keyed by schema attribute name.

given_name.description: Claim value for the holder's given name.

tier.description: Claim value for the holder's membership tier.

credential_id.description: Unique identifier of the issued credential.

vct.description: VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) value of the issued credential.

sd_jwt.description: Serialized SD-JWT VC (Selective-Disclosure JWT Verifiable Credential). The captured value was redacted.

status_idx.description: Status-list index assigned to the issued credential.

GET /v1/credentials.description: List issued credentials for your tenant. Each credential includes lifecycle status, issuer, validity timestamps, holder confirmation key, and source session information. Use this to manage issued credentials after issuance.

200.description: Array of issued credential records. Each array element contains these fields.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the issued credential.

vct.description: VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) value of the issued credential.

iss.description: Issuer URL that issued the credential.

status_idx.description: Status-list index assigned to the credential.

issued_at.description: Timestamp when the credential was issued.

holder_cnf.description: Holder confirmation key as a JWK (JSON Web Key) object. Some captured list records include private key material.

crv.description: Elliptic curve name in the JWK (JSON Web Key).

d.description: Private key parameter included on some captured JWK (JSON Web Key) holder confirmation objects.

source_session_id.description: Source Didit verification session identifier. The captured records use an empty string when no source session is linked.

detail.description: Error detail returned by the API.

params.description: UUID of the issued credential to revoke.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the issued credential.

vct.description: VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) value of the issued credential.

issued_at.description: Timestamp when the credential was issued.

holder_cnf.description: Holder confirmation key as a JWK (JSON Web Key) object.

crv.description: Elliptic curve name in the JWK (JSON Web Key).

source_session_id.description: Source Didit verification session identifier. The captured record uses an empty string when no source session is linked.

detail.description: Error detail returned by the API.
detail.example: Cannot revoke a credential in status 'revoked'.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of the issued credential.

vct.description: VCT (Verifiable Credential Type) value of the issued credential.

status_idx.description: Status-list index assigned to the credential.

issued_at.description: Timestamp when the credential was issued.

holder_cnf.description: Holder confirmation key as a JWK (JSON Web Key) object.

crv.description: Elliptic curve name in the JWK (JSON Web Key).

source_session_id.description: Source Didit verification session identifier. The captured record uses an empty string when no source session is linked.

detail.description: Error detail returned by the API.

issued_at.description: Timestamp when the credential was issued.
